description: Run a raw Overpass QL query against OpenStreetMap. Use for complex spatial queries the helper tools can't express. Example: `[out:json][timeout:25]; area["name"="Berlin"][admin_level=4]->.a; node["amenity"="library"](area.a); out body;`. Returns the raw Overpass JSON (elements array with node/way/relation).

qql.description: Full Overpass QL query string. Start with `[out:json][timeout:<n>];` and end with `out body;` (or similar output statement).

name: query

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate or null if unavailable

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate or null if unavailable

name.description: OSM name tag value or null

osm_url.description: Direct link to element on OpenStreetMap

tags.description: All OSM tags as key-value pairs

title: Query
